sloka: न खल्वहम् न गच्छेयम् वनम् जनकनन्दिनि ।वचनम् त्न्नयति माम् पितुः सत्योपबृंहितम् ॥२-३०-३१॥
transliteration: na khalvaham na gaccheyam vanam janakanandini ।vacanam tnnayati mām pituḥ satyopabṛṁhitam ॥2-30-31॥

translations.english: Not that I shall not go to the forest (go I must). My father's word nourished by truth is leading me there, O daughter of Janaka
